central_claim: Across four separate literatures that had never been combined, the NR4A3 5' fusion partner is a CANDIDATE and not an established stratification variable: the treatment-response signal is directional only (0 of 3-5 TAF15 patients, upper bound above the comparator's point estimate), the prognostic contrast now has a first pooled crude magnitude (7/15 = 46.7 % vs 6/58 = 10.3 %) that arrives with its own defeater from the larger cohort's own multivariable model, and TAF15::NR4A3 covers 28/154 = 18.2 % (12.9-25.0) of partner-assigned EMC -- an interval that, as of this round, is claimed to CONTAIN rather than correct the ~20 % the paper's own cited literature states.
